answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 76 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in gale, queued in crystal, and lagoon publishes the wait time. A farm of 26 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4631 identities would post 4747 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
